title: Harbor plan approval binding
$comment: Private file platform/registry/approval.yaml. A merged PR carrying this binding approves exactly one binding content hash (sha256 of the reviewed binding.yaml bytes) and one plan digest; the Harbor settings executor applies that plan with no second operator command. Merging the approval PR keeps the binding bytes identical, so the approval stays satisfiable; stale or mismatched bindings never apply. Undeclared projects and memberships stay retained; any plan containing a delete or replace action is refused.
